title: τ(M, θ, ξ) of a rectifiable triple is a current
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, V, M ⊆ ℝ^P (V arbitrary, not necessarily open), θ : ℝ^P → ℝ and ξ : ℝ^P → Λₙ(ℝ^P) (n-vectors, NVector (Eucl P) n = continuous linear functionals on n-covectors). Assume (M, θ, ξ) satisfies the triple conditions of Simon Ch. 6, 3.1 relative to V (IsRectifiableTriple V n M θ ξ): M ⊆ V is Hⁿ-null-measurable and countably n-rectifiable, θ > 0 on M, θ is Hⁿ-integrable on M ∩ K for every compact K ⊆ V, ξ is Hⁿ⌞M-a.e. strongly measurable, and for Hⁿ⌞M-a.e. x, ξ(x) = ±τ₁ ∧ ⋯ ∧ τₙ for an orthonormal τ spanning a weighted approximate tangent space of (M, θ) at x (Hⁿ = μHE[n]). Then τ(M, θ, ξ)(ω) = ∫_M θ(x)⟨ω(x), ξ(x)⟩ dHⁿ(x) (tauAction n M θ ξ ω) defines a current: there is X ∈ Dₙ(V) (GeometricCurrentOn V n: an ℝ-linear functional on the test forms Dⁿ(V) that is sequentially continuous in Simon's test-form topology) with X(ω) = τ(M, θ, ξ)(ω) for every ω ∈ Dⁿ(V).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (V M : Set (Eucl P)) (θ : Eucl P → ℝ) (ξ : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) n), IsRectifiableTriple V n M θ ξ → ∃ X : GeometricCurrentOn V n, ∀ ω : TestFormOn V n, X ω = tauAction n M θ ξ ω
